purpose: Bounded boost-bypass presence trial at the existing Linux board voltage, compared with csi-trial settle=22 baseline.
board_limit: 3.6 V maximum; Windows CAMT requests 4.0 V, which this trial did not reproduce
conclusion: Baseline and boost-enabled trials both ended with zero CSID3 packets, ECC, and CRC. During the boost variant, pmi8994_boostbypass showed enable=1/use_count=1 at 3.6 V. After cleanup it returned to disabled. Since the Windows 4.0 V condition was not tested, this does not exclude a 4.0 V-specific effect.
cleanup: Sensor stop and receiver release returned zero; camera services were restored; boost, torch, and flash channels were left off.
publication: local only; no Git push or PR
